# Calls a parser makes on Tika's XHTMLContentHandler, which HandlerChainReference.java runs through
# extractous's handler chains to write chains.tsv. One script per `== name` section, one call per
# line, fields separated by tabs; text escapes \n, \t, \\, \uXXXX and \UXXXXXXXX. After the meta lines,
# every script starts with start-document and ends with end-document, which the Rust side writes
# itself around a parser's calls.
#   meta NAME VALUE          Metadata.addTrusted before the parse starts
#   start-document           end-document
#   start NAME [ATTR VALUE]...
#   end NAME                 chars TEXT    ws TEXT    newline    element NAME VALUE

== paragraphs
meta	Content-Type	application/rtf
meta	tk:resource-name	prose.rtf
meta	Content-Length	5470
meta	tk:parsed-by	org.apache.tika.parser.microsoft.rtf.RTFParser
meta	dcterms:created	2026-01-01T00:00:00Z
start-document
start	p
start	b
end	b
start	b
chars	The Lighthouse Keeper's Ledger
end	b
end	p
start	p
chars	Every evening at dusk the keeper climbed.
end	p
element	p	Second paragraph.
element	p
end-document

== title-language-and-many-values
meta	dc:title	A <Title> & "more"
meta	title	not in the head
meta	Content-Language	da
meta	dc:creator	First
meta	dc:creator	Second
meta	tk:parsed-by	a
meta	tk:parsed-by	b
start-document
element	h1	Overskrift
element	p	Brødtekst med æøå.
end-document

== escaping-and-invalid-characters
start-document
start	p	class	a "quoted" <value> & more	data-x	bell\u0007here
chars	1 < 2 & 3 > 2 "quoted" 'single'
chars	controls \u0001\u0008\u000b\u000c\u001f kept \t and \r
chars	c1 \u007f\u0085\u009f nonchar ￿￾ end
chars	astral \U0001F600 ok
end	p
end-document

== empty-elements-and-whitespace
start-document
start	div
end	div
start	p
ws	\u0020\u0020\u0020
end	p
start	br
end	br
newline
ws	\t
chars	tail
end-document

== table-cells-with-paragraphs
start-document
start	table
start	tr
start	td
start	p
chars	Year
end	p
start	p
chars	1888
end	p
end	td
start	td
start	p
chars	Ships
end	p
end	td
start	td
ws	\u0020
end	td
end	tr
start	tr
start	th
chars	Header
end	th
start	td
chars	direct
start	p
chars	then paragraph
end	p
ws	\u0020
start	p
chars	again
end	p
end	td
end	tr
end	table
element	p	after the table
end-document

== lists-and-definitions
start-document
start	ul
element	li	one
element	li	two
end	ul
start	dl
element	dt	term
element	dd	definition
end	dl
start	ol
start	li
element	p	in item
end	li
end	ol
end-document

== anchored-block-in-paragraph
start-document
start	p
chars	The sentence begins
start	div	class	annotation
start	p
chars	A comment anchored here.
end	p
end	div
chars	 and ends here.
end	p
start	p
start	div	class	before-text
chars	A block before any text stays.
end	div
chars	Text after it.
end	p
start	p
chars	Footnote
start	p
end	p
ws	\n
chars	 reference.
end	p
end-document

== unbalanced-end-tags
start-document
start	div
start	span
chars	open span
end	div
end	b
start	p
chars	unclosed paragraph
end-document

== style-and-script
start-document
start	style
chars	p { color: red }
end	style
start	p
chars	visible
start	script
chars	alert(1)
end	script
start	SCRIPT
chars	upper
end	SCRIPT
chars	 text
end	p
end-document

== head-elements-and-auto
start-document
start	head
start	meta	name	description	content	Explicit
end	meta
start	link	rel	stylesheet
end	link
end	head
start	title
chars	Explicit title element
end	title
element	p	Body text.
end-document

== frameset
meta	dc:title	Frames
start-document
start	frameset
start	frame	src	a.html
end	frame
end	frameset
end-document

== no-content
meta	Content-Type	text/plain
start-document
end-document

== write-limit
start-document
element	p	Ninety characters of text so that the small write limit cuts it in the middle of a word.
start	p
chars	Straddling astral \U0001F600\U0001F600 characters at the limit.
end	p
element	p	Never written under the small limit.
end-document
